name: linter-luau
description: Autocomplete for the things luau-lsp cannot see: dynamic module lists, custom require, _G/shared, shared tables, framework-supplied parameters. Includes the Luau language definition and grammar from the luau-lsp extension (MIT).

commands.title: Linter: Show scripts only partly understood

linter.root.description: Folder holding bridge/, server/, core/ (default: the extension's own copy).

linter.luauLspPath.description: Path to the luau-lsp binary (default: LUAU_LSP, PATH, or the JohnnyMorganz.luau-lsp extension's binary).

linter.lunePath.description: Path to the Lune runtime (default: tools/lune in the runtime folder, then PATH).

linter.timeoutMs.description: How long a completion waits for Linter after luau-lsp has answered.

linter.checkArguments.description: Warn about arguments whose type cannot match the parameter.

linter.suggestArguments.description: Offer the parameter and allowed strings/enums inside f(.

linter.suggestIndexes.description: Offer array positions after a dot (writes [1]).

linter.suggestBracketKeys.description: Offer names that cannot follow a dot as ["Name"].

linter.suggestAttributeNames.description: Offer attribute and tag names inside GetAttribute(" / HasTag(".

linter.globalsScan.description: Discover _G / shared members by evaluating scripts that write them.

linter.contributorScan.description: Show what other modules write into a shared table.

linter.trimStudioList.description: Remove members marked --@Private/--@Hidden from luau-lsp's list too.

linter.checkMembers.description: Point out a misspelled member of a table or child of an instance when a close name exists ("Did you mean ...?"), and calling a value that is not a function.

linter.checkArgumentCount.description: Point out more arguments than a function takes. Off by default: callbacks often get extra arguments on purpose.

linter.checkMissingChildren.description: Point out WaitForChild("X") when the project files contain no X. Off by default: many children are created at run time.

linter.hideMovedErrors.description: Hide luau-lsp's false "not found" errors for instances that a script moves into place at run time.

enumDescriptions: Linter never writes anything into your project. A sourcemap.json that already exists is only read (default).
Linter asks Rojo to create and keep sourcemap.json in your project folder (this writes a file into the project).
linter.sourcemap.mode.description: Whether Linter may create sourcemap.json for luau-lsp's game-tree types. Linter's own engine does not need it.

linter.advanced.description: Any other engine option (requestBudgetMs, moduleMs, maxItems ...).
